data.completion_memo: Implemented inert bounded manifest parsing, exact version/hash/generation pinning, a bounded framed language-neutral protocol, supervised persistent subprocess lifecycle, scrubbed environment and process-group cleanup, watchdog/health/restart/disable/drift/cancel/shutdown behavior, persistent crash budgets, bounded settlement retention, and no replay after ambiguous dispatch. Critical verification passed: 13 plugin tests including real Python subprocess fixtures plus Adashi QA job #9 / run #25.
data.description: Implement parse-before-execution manifests and the language-neutral trusted plugin subprocess protocol for explicitly enabled, compatible, exact-version contributions. Add bounded handshake, invocation, health, crash, restart, disable, update/drift handling, and truthful disclosure that same-user trusted plugins are not security sandboxes.
